data.name: BOLO and The curse of the Dark Prophecy
data.detailed_description:
BOLO AND CURSE OF THE DARK PROPHECY

Story -

For centuries, the Kingdom of The Shadow Moon stood protected beneath the Sacred MoonStone Crystal — a relic forged by forgotten gods.

But the prophecy was never destroyed.

Only hidden.

Now the skies burn black. Ancient monsters rise from the abyss. Entire kingdoms fall into shadow. And a mysterious warlord seeks to awaken a power capable of reshaping reality itself.

Dark forces takes Princess (Powerful Witch) into their layer for the prophecy to be fulfilled.

In this dying world, one unlikely hero must rise.

A warrior named Bolo.

Bolo is not a chosen king.

Not a legendary god.

He is a lone fox warrior carrying the burden of a forgotten destiny.

After witnessing the destruction of his homeland, Bolo embarks on a dangerous journey across cursed lands, ancient temples, and fallen kingdoms to uncover the truth behind the prophecy before darkness consumes the world forever.

Armed with mystical weapons and ancient magic, Bolo must confront terrifying enemies, corrupted guardians, and monstrous titans standing between him and salvation.

BOLO — THE LAST FLAME BEARER

Bolo was once a simple guardian living among the hidden clans of Velkar Forest.

Everything changed the night the sky turned crimson.

A mysterious army led by the Dark Lord destroyed moonlight castle in search of princess.

Bolo survived.

But during the attack, he was granted a forbidden power connected to the Eternal Flame itself.

Now hunted by dark forces and haunted by visions of the prophecy, Bolo must journey across cursed kingdoms to uncover the truth about his destiny.

THE DARK LORD RISES

The Dark Lord was once a forgotten emperor who sought immortality through eclipse magic.

Banished by the ancient guardians centuries ago, he now returns stronger than ever — commanding corrupted beasts, shadow armies, and monstrous gods born from darkness.

His goal:

To consume the Eternal Flame and reshape the world under eternal night.

And standing between him and total domination is one warrior.

Bolo.

JOIN THE LEGEND

The prophecy has awakened.

The kingdom is falling.

And Bolo’s journey is only beginning.

Join us in bringing Bolo and the Curse of the Prophecy to life.

A CINEMATIC DARK FANTASY ADVENTURE

Bolo Legends: Curse of the Prophecy is a cinematic action RPG inspired by legendary fantasy adventures.

Players will experience:

⚔️ Brutal melee combat
✨ Ancient elemental magic
👹 Massive cinematic boss battles
🌍 Dark fantasy world exploration
🎵 Emotional orchestral soundtrack
📖 Story-driven adventure filled with mystery and betrayal

Every kingdom hides secrets.
Every battle shapes destiny.

Conclusion -

A challenge awaits all who seek it here, whether you are a first-time Player or old, BOLO does not disappoint amazing you with his capabilities, it puzzles, hack and slash combat with a lot of adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 Home Edition - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i3 - 4370
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 Home Edition - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 6700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3500x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX Vega-56
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
